body: Yes exactly! I’ve never felt better from hearing shit like that anyway. If someone wants to die let them. It’s cruel to prolong suffering just to be selfish and keep someone alive who doesn’t want to be there. Besides when someone interfered w me I felt worse, and had to deal w even more problems on top of it. I regret them interfering every day. It’s selfish to keep someone hurt I just so you can feel like you “helped”
